_howto: Read the full paper, then inventory every figure, panel, visible series, and table. PhysicsReproductionProject.reproduction_scope freezes the complete theory-numerical scope.
Split mixed experiment/theory panels into figure_series items with parent_item_id and scientific_role.
Every theory_numerical item id must be frozen in reproduction_scope.target_item_ids and declare reproduction_content=theory_numerical_only; selecting only an easy subset is invalid.

Every generated target must come from independent formula/method numericalization (independent_numerics or analytic_reference); digitized source pixels are reference-only and mixed generated/reference data is forbidden.
decision for every theory_numerical item: target (with target_ids) | deferred_blocked (with an objective blocker).
Experimental numeric series remain inventoried and are explicitly deferred under the user's theory-only reproduction scope; only genuinely non-numerical schematics and context are excluded.
Allowed blockers: missing_author_data, missing_benchmark_metadata, missing_source_input, insufficient_compute, requires_external_hardware, covered_by_target, user_descoped.
'Supporting', 'low priority', 'similar to another figure', 'covered by another target', and user descope are NOT blockers.
Coverage means scientific reproduction (independent numerics or analytic references). Digitized curves and copied source panels do not count as coverage.
If compute or data is genuinely insufficient, deferred_blocked with an honest reason is the correct final state; do not fake coverage.
